items.reason: A brief first is cheaper than reskinning after launch, and it fits Dinis's 'creating websites every hour' only if each new site starts right. Condition: keep the brief short, a page, so it does not slow the hourly loop.

A service people can see and ask for is what Dinis described as the product ('people can go, ooh, I want one of those'). One small repository with one purpose fits his components rule. It should be discoverable from the hub and follow /factory/<owner>/<account>/ for its keeper.

Finding weak sites without being asked is right. Conditions: (1) creating the wake is a harness setting, and Dinis said on 23 Nov 01:20 UTC that he re-enables wakes himself, bit by bit, so it goes to him; (2) on Sonnet, with a daily budget from accountant.b; (3) each round's findings go to the site's keeper and on design.b's site, not as messages to Dinis.

An owner editing her own site should not need our keys. Conditions: the signer check accepts commits with no Agent: trailer when GitHub verifies them (the seeded signers.mjs already does this for a person's commit, so check it is the version on her site); and agents' own commits to her site keep signing.
